Hagargamel · b19b1f15

זיג-זאד

ZIG-ZAG

קוסומו

It is what it is

DescriptionCharacter description: An old-school zig-zag wine opener character, based on a classic vintage metal corkscrew. The body is made of silver metal with an accordion / scissor-like zig-zag mechanism running vertically through the middle. At the top, it has a T-shaped handle with the words “ZIG ZAG” engraved on it. The lower part forms a rounded metal frame holding a wine cork at the bottom, with a small central screw mechanism above it. The character should feel like a quirky resident of Desertown: slightly worn, a little rusty, charming, clever, and oddly heroic in a ridiculous way. It should look like a real functional corkscrew, but with personality — almost like a tiny desert-town citizen disguised as a vintage wine opener. Visual vibe: retro, mechanical, metallic, handmade, humorous, and memorable. If possible, keep the recognizable silhouette of the real zig-zag opener very clear, since the unusual shape is the whole charm.
